import Definitions.Def_FermatCurveFieldBasic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.FieldDivision
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.IntegralClosure
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.PID
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Valuation.LocalSubring

/-!
# Affine charts of a curve field

For `t` in a curve field `K` transcendental over `ℚ`, the *chart ring* `A_t` is the integral
closure of `ℚ[t] = Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}` in `K`. It is the coordinate ring of the affine
open `{t ≠ ∞}` of the regular proper model of the curve: a Dedekind domain, finite over
`ℚ[t]`, of finite type over `ℚ`, with fraction field `K`. Every place of `K` containing `t` is
the localisation of `A_t` at a height-one prime (see `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place`).

The instances depending on the transcendence of `t` take the hypothesis in the form
`[Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)]`.

## Main definitions and results

* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing t`: the integral closure of `ℚ[t]` in `K`.
* instances `IsDedekindDomain (chartRing t)`, `IsFractionRing (chartRing t) K`,
  `Module.Finite (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) (chartRing t)`, `Algebra.FiniteType ℚ (chartRing t)`.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing_le`: `A_t` is contained in every integrally closed subring
  containing `ℚ` and `t` (e.g. valuation subrings).
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.inv_notMem_chartRing`: `t⁻¹ ∉ A_t`, i.e. `t` is not a unit of `A_t`.
-/

open Polynomial
open scoped IntermediateField IntermediateField.algebraAdjoinAdjoin

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]

/-- The chart ring `A_t`: the integral closure of `ℚ[t]` in `K`. -/
abbrev chartRing (t : K) : Subalgebra (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) K :=
  integralClosure (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) K

variable {t : K}

theorem mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin {x : K} (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :
    x ∈ chartRing t :=
  (chartRing t).algebraMap_mem ⟨x, hx⟩

variable (t) in
theorem self_mem_chartRing : t ∈ chartRing t :=
  mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin (Algebra.self_mem_adjoin_singleton ℚ t)

variable (t) in
theorem ratCast_mem_chartRing (q : ℚ) : (q : K) ∈ chartRing t :=
  mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ q)

/-- The chart ring is contained in every integrally closed subring containing `ℚ` and `t`. -/
theorem chartRing_le {S : Subring K} [IsIntegrallyClosedIn S K] (hq : ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ S)
    (ht : t ∈ S) : (chartRing t).toSubring ≤ S := by
  rw [Subring.integralClosure_le_iff]
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  change r ∈ S
  induction hr using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx => obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx; exact ht
  | algebraMap q => exact hq q
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact S.add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => exact S.mul_mem hx hy

/-- The chart ring is contained in every valuation subring containing `ℚ` and `t`. -/
theorem mem_of_mem_chartRing (V : ValuationSubring K) (hq : ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ V)
    (ht : t ∈ V) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ chartRing t) : x ∈ V := by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn V.toSubring K := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn V K)
  exact chartRing_le (S := V.toSubring) hq ht hx

theorem isDedekindDomain_adjoin (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    IsDedekindDomain (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) := by
  have e := Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental ℚ t ht
  have : IsPrincipalIdealRing (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :=
    IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective
  infer_instance

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : IsDedekindDomain (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :=
  isDedekindDomain_adjoin Fact.out

/-- The element `t` is not a unit of the chart ring `A_t`. -/
theorem inv_notMem_chartRing (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) : t⁻¹ ∉ chartRing t := by
  have := isDedekindDomain_adjoin ht
  intro h
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental ht
  let y : ℚ⟮t⟯ := ⟨t⁻¹, inv_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ t)⟩
  have hy : IsIntegral (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) y := by
    rw [← isIntegral_algHom_iff (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) ℚ⟮t⟯ K)
      (algebraMap ℚ⟮t⟯ K).injective]
    exact h
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp hy
  have hr' : (r : K) = t⁻¹ := congrArg Subtype.val hr
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℚ[X], aeval t p = r := by
    have : (r : K) ∈ (aeval (R := ℚ) t).range := by
      rw [← Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval]; exact r.2
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := this
    exact ⟨p, hp⟩
  apply ht
  refine ⟨X * p - 1, fun h0 ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · 0) h0
    simp at this
  · simp [hp, hr', ht0]

variable [IsCurveField K]

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮t⟯ K :=
  finiteDimensional_adjoin Fact.out

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : IsFractionRing (chartRing t) K :=
  integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension ℚ⟮t⟯ K

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : IsDedekindDomain (chartRing t) :=
  IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) ℚ⟮t⟯ K (chartRing t)

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : Module.Finite (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) (chartRing t) :=
  IsIntegralClosure.finite (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) ℚ⟮t⟯ K (chartRing t)

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : Algebra.FiniteType ℚ (chartRing t) := by
  have : Algebra.FiniteType ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :=
    .adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_singleton t)
  exact Algebra.FiniteType.trans (S := Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) inferInstance inferInstance

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

> “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K, chartRing t is the integral closure in K of the ℚ-subalgebra ℚ[t] generated by t.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For all t,x∈K, if x∈ℚ[t], then x∈A_t.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.self_mem_chartRing`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K, t∈A_t.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ratCast_mem_chartRing`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K and q∈ℚ, the image of q in K lies in A_t.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing_le`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K and subring S⊆K integrally closed in K, if S contains every rational number and t, then A_t⊆S.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.mem_of_mem_chartRing`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K and valuation subring V⊆K containing ℚ and t, every x∈A_t belongs to V.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isDedekindDomain_adjoin`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K transcendental over ℚ, ℚ[t] is a Dedekind domain.

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K supplied as transcendental over ℚ, ℚ[t] is a Dedekind domain.

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K transcendental over ℚ, t⁻¹∉A_t.

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(t).

For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. Fix any t∈K transcendental over ℚ. A_t is a Dedekind domain.

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. Fix any t∈K transcendental over ℚ. A_t is a finitely generated module over ℚ[t].

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. Fix any t∈K transcendental over ℚ. A_t is a finitely generated ℚ-algebra.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意 t∈K，仿射图环 A_t 定义为由 t 生成的有理数子代数 ℚ[t] 在 K 中的整闭包。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意 t,x∈K，若 x∈ℚ[t]，则 x∈A_t。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.self_mem_chartRing`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意 t∈K，都有 t∈A_t。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ratCast_mem_chartRing`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意 t∈K 和 q∈ℚ，q 在 K 中的像属于 A_t。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing_le`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意 t∈K 及在 K 中整闭的子环 S，若 S 包含所有有理数和 t，则 A_t⊆S。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.mem_of_mem_chartRing`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意 t∈K 及包含有理数域和 t 的赋值子环 V⊆K，每个 x∈A_t 都属于 V。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isDedekindDomain_adjoin`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意关于有理数域超越的 t∈K，ℚ[t] 是 Dedekind 整环。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart.instance@84`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意附有关于有理数域超越证明的 t∈K，ℚ[t] 是 Dedekind 整环。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.inv_notMem_chartRing`

设 K 为任意特征零域。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。对任意关于有理数域超越的 t∈K，有 t⁻¹∉A_t。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart.instance@112`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。固定任意关于有理数域超越的 t∈K。K 在 ℚ(t) 上有限维。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart.instance@115`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。固定任意关于有理数域超越的 t∈K。K 是 A_t 的分式域。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart.instance@118`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。固定任意关于有理数域超越的 t∈K。A_t 是 Dedekind 整环。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart.instance@121`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。固定任意关于有理数域超越的 t∈K。A_t 是 ℚ[t] 上的有限生成模。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart.instance@124`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。对每个 t∈K，ℚ[t] 指由 t 生成的有理数子代数，A_t=chartRing t 是其在 K 中的整闭包，即 K 中在 ℚ[t] 上整的元素组成的环。固定任意关于有理数域超越的 t∈K。A_t 是有理数域上的有限生成代数。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing`

K を任意の標数零の体とする。各 t∈K に対し、ℚ[t] は t が生成する有理数部分代数、A_t=chartRing t はその K における整閉包、すなわち ℚ[t] 上整である K の元からなる環を表す。任意の t∈K に対し、アフィンチャート環 A_t は t の生成する有理数部分代数 ℚ[t] の K における整閉包である。
